result.instructions: Tools for AiSensy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my WhatsApp templates are approved, and which were rejected?"; "How did my Diwali campaign perform: delivered, read and failed counts?"; "Find the contact with number 919876543210 and show their tags.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AiSensy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run aisensy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run aisensy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run aisensy_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. aisensy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: aisensy_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: The AiSensy project (WhatsApp account) this key belongs to: name, status, plan and renewal date, monthly active user quota and usage, credit balance (raw units as AiSensy reports them), WhatsApp number, display name status, quality rating and messaging tier. GET /project/{project_id}.

tools.name: aisensy_list_templates
tools.title: List WhatsApp templates
tools.description: List the WhatsApp template messages of the project with name, language, status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED), category, text and parameter count. Only APPROVED templates can be sent. Pages by record id: pass next_after from the previous reply as `after`. GET /project/{project_id}/wa_template/.

after.description: Return records after this template id (exclusive); use the previous reply's next_after.

before.description: Return records before this template id (exclusive).

tools.name: aisensy_get_template
tools.title: Get WhatsApp template
tools.description: One WhatsApp template by id, with status, rejection reason, buttons and text. GET /project/{project_id}/wa_template/{id}.

template_id.description: AiSensy record id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: aisensy_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns (API campaigns, broadcasts or both) with name, type, status, audience size, submitted count, template and creation time. Pages with skip + limit. POST /project/{project_id}/campaigns (a read: it only queries).

tools.name: aisensy_list_api_campaigns
tools.title: List API campaigns
tools.description: List the project's API campaigns (the campaigns messages can be sent through) with status and template. A campaign must be LIVE to send. GET /project/{project_id}/campaign/api.

tools.name: aisensy_get_api_campaign
tools.title: Get API campaign
tools.description: One API campaign by id: status, template, parameters and counts. GET /project/{project_id}/campaign/api/{campaign_id}.

campaign_id.description: AiSensy record id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: aisensy_get_campaign_analytics
tools.title: Get campaign analytics
tools.description: Daily delivery and credit-usage statistics of one campaign (sent, delivered, read, failed counts and message credit usage), optionally within a date range. POST /project/{project_id}/campaign/analytics/{campaign_id} (a read: it only queries).

campaign_id.description: AiSensy record id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: aisensy_list_campaign_audience
tools.title: List campaign audience
tools.description: Who a campaign was sent to, with name, number and sent/delivered/read times, optionally filtered by outcome (SENT, DELIVERED, READ, FAILED, REPLIED, CLICKED) and date range. Pages by cursor: pass next_after from the previous reply as `after`. GET /project/{project_id}/campaign/audience/{campaign_id}.

campaign_id.description: AiSensy record id (as returned by the list tools).

after.description: Cursor from the previous reply's next_after.

tools.name: aisensy_create_api_campaign
tools.title: Create API campaign
tools.description: WRITE: create an API campaign that binds a name to an APPROVED WhatsApp template. It sends nothing; messages go out only when aisensy_send_campaign_message is called for it. Not idempotent: calling twice with the same name may create two campaigns or fail. POST /project/{project_id}/campaign/api.

template_name.description: Exact name of an APPROVED template (see aisensy_list_templates).

tools.name: aisensy_find_contact
tools.title: Find contact by phone number
tools.description: Look up a contact by phone number: id, name, tags, attributes, opt-in/chat state and last activity. 404 means no such contact. GET /project/{project_id}/contact?action=FetchContact&mobile_number=.

phone_number.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. 919876543210 (digits; a leading + is dropped).

tools.name: aisensy_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id: name, phone number, tags, attributes, chat state and last activity. GET /project/{project_id}/contact/{contact_id}.

contact_id.description: AiSensy record id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: aisensy_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (name and phone number with country code). AiSensy opts new contacts in to WhatsApp notifications automatically, so only add people who agreed to be messaged. A number that already exists returns a 409 conflict. POST /project/{project_id}/contact.

phone_number.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. 919876543210 (digits; a leading + is dropped).

tools.name: aisensy_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's name, custom attributes, WhatsApp opt-in status or blocked status. Setting opted_in=false stops campaign messages to that person; blocked=true blocks them. Only the fields you pass change. PATCH /project/{project_id}/contact/{contact_id}.

contact_id.description: AiSensy record id (as returned by the list tools).

opted_in.description: Whether the contact accepts WhatsApp notifications.

attributes.description: Contact attributes as name → text value. AiSensy ignores attribute names that do not exist in the project.

tools.name: aisensy_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: One WhatsApp message by id: status (SENT, DELIVERED, READ), sent/delivered/read times, sender, campaign, content and price. GET /project/{project_id}/messages/{message_id}.

message_id.description: AiSensy record id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: aisensy_send_campaign_message
tools.title: Send campaign message
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS A WHATSAPP MESSAGE TO A CUSTOMER AND SPENDS AISENSY CREDIT: send the template of a LIVE API campaign to one phone number (a new contact is created if the number is unknown). Not idempotent: every call sends again. template_params must match the template's parameter count. Show the user the recipient and the template first and set confirm=true only after they approve. POST /project/{project_id}/campaign/api/send.

campaign_name.description: Name of a LIVE API campaign (see aisensy_list_api_campaigns).

phone_number.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. 919876543210 (digits; a leading + is dropped).

template_params.description: Values for the template's {{1}}, {{2}}... in order; the count must match the template.

media_url.description: Public https URL of the image/video/document for a media template.

media_filename.description: File name shown for the media.

tags.description: Existing tags to put on the contact (unknown tags are ignored).

attributes.description: Contact attributes as name → text value. AiSensy ignores attribute names that do not exist in the project.

default_country_code.description: Country code to assume when phone_number has none, e.g. 91.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has seen and approved the recipient and the message in this conversation.

tools.name: aisensy_send_message
tools.title: Send WhatsApp message
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS A WHATSAPP MESSAGE TO A CUSTOMER AND MAY SPEND AISENSY CREDIT: send either a free-text message (type=text; WhatsApp only delivers it inside the 24-hour window after the customer last wrote) or an approved template (type=template with template_name, language_code and body_params). Not idempotent. Show the user the recipient and the text first and set confirm=true only after they approve. POST /project/{project_id}/messages.

phone_number.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. 919876543210 (digits; a leading + is dropped).

type.description: text = free-form reply; template = an approved template.

language_code.description: Template language code such as en, en_US, hi (type=template; default en).

body_params.description: Values for the template's body {{1}}, {{2}}... in order (type=template).

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has seen and approved the recipient and the message in this conversation.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with AiSensy
prompts.description: What you can do with AiSensy here, with example requests to try.
